spec.text: Image 1 is the man's character model sheet; image 2 is the woman's character model sheet; image 3 is a real photo of the man's family home; image 4 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). A sunny afternoon in Yunlin in front of the man's family home from image 3: a narrow three-story concrete townhouse with white metal window grilles, a balcony, closed rolling shutters on the ground floor, a potted plant and a leafy tree by the door. The man, smiling proudly, gestures toward the house, showing the woman his home; she looks up at it, curious and happy. Only the two of them. Every character must be rendered as a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, with faces, glasses, hairstyles and outfits identical to their references, never as a flat 2D drawing. Mouths closed in small gentle smiles. Recreate any real place from the photos in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques, screens or documents are blank; no readable text. No other people. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
